title: the water tower Rising
author: Emrys Sandoval
blurb: Emrys Nystrom, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, has spent five years being so careful it hurts. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before the last game of the season.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
